about_the_game:
Ultimate Stick Battle (USB) is a 2D fighting game that looks simple — stick figures, clean stages — but don’t let that fool you. Underneath is a deep, competitive game built around precision, creativity, and straight-up skill.

Think Smash Bros. meets classic arcade fighters, but with a unique twist:

  • Directional combat with light & heavy attacks

  • Rollbacks for smooth local play

  • Freshly made stage 

  • With Retro Music

  • And characters designed for mind games, not just button mashing

USB is made for the people who want to pick up a game for fun — and then realize hours have flown by because they have to get better. Whether you’re fighting a cracked AI or sweating locally, it’s all about getting in, learning the tech, and earning your wins.

This isn’t just another stick game. It’s the stick game that wants to stand toe-to-toe with the best in the genre.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 (Catalina) or newer
  • Processor: Dual‑core Intel (64‑bit) or Apple Silicon (e.g. M1/M2)
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated “AGX” GPU on Apple Silicon or Intel Iris / AMD integrated
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard macOS audio output
  • Additional Notes: Processor lower might work but it probably will be slower.

name: Ultimate Stick Battle - Beta

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 64‑bit Windows 10, build 19041 or newer
  • Processor: SSE‑2 capable Intel/AMD dual‑core
  • Memory: 4096 MB MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU with DirectX 10 / OpenGL 3.2 support
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Meets OS‑level audio output
  • VR Support: Not Supported
  • Additional Notes: Game runs in 64‑bit mode by default

short_description: Ultimate Stick Battle (USB) is a fast-paced 2D fighting game where simple stick visuals meet deep, competitive gameplay. Master light and heavy directional attacks, outplay evolving stages, and climb the ranks with smooth rollback netcode. Easy to learn — hard to master — impossible to put down.
